resources.string: One nadir pass and four fixed-heading oblique passes. GSD is a nadir estimate; inspect the full route and validate image coverage before survey use.
Tap centreline points or import a KML LineString. Parallel strips follow the bends; sharp turns must be split. Review connectors and clearance.
Draw the building footprint. Circular layers face its centre. Width sets clearance outside the footprint; this is not obstacle sensing or a facade model.
Full corridor width, or surround distance outside the footprint.

This reports connection and upload state. It does not verify Broadcast Remote ID or grant permission to fly. Offline samples remain on this device until uploaded within the declaration window.

Experimental Mini 2 survey control. Take off manually first, use an open supervised test area, and keep the app connected. Stop or move a physical stick to take control. Limits: 3 m/s, 200 m radius, 25% battery reserve. No obstacle avoidance is provided. Not field qualified.
Tap to load. Long-press to export or delete. Exported plans include locations; share them only with approved recipients.
